findings.highlight: I won't take up on your offer.
findings.evidenceJa: おまえの話には乗らない
findings.explanation: Take up on your offer mixes two acceptance idioms.

findings.highlight: at the cost of just one arm
findings.evidenceJa: この程度で藤ねえが助かるなら
findings.governingReading: この程度 refers to Caster’s demand to remove the seal with skin/flesh; the preceding narration expects taking the seal with flesh by one utterance.
findings.explanation: The offered seal-bearing flesh becomes the cost of a whole arm.

findings.evidenceJa: 血を吐くような懸命さで
findings.governingReading: The narrator describes Saber’s desperately earnest pleading with a blood-vomiting simile.
